timeout: The game server took too long to answer. Check your connection and try again.
generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

serverProblem: The game server had a problem. Please try again later.

authBadReply: The game server sent an unreadable reply (%{status}).

providerDisabled: That sign-in method is not available on this server.

limit: A limit was reached. Leave or finish something first.
invalidRequest: The game server could not use that request.
